Vicon Creator · On-location photography

Photographer in Amsterdam

A photoshoot in Amsterdam can be a quiet walk together, a personal portrait or time with your family. Vicon Creator works on location, with cinematic colour and expressive black-and-white photography. Start with the kind of day you want to have, then choose the backdrop.

Canals or a more personal setting?

The Jordaan combines canal streets, bridges and a residential feel. A short route there can suit couples and individual portraits, but a landmark does not have to be the goal. A street you know or a place connected to your relationship may tell more of your story. Choose one neighbourhood instead of trying to fit the whole city into a session.

Plan the route around people

Tell me whether you are visiting Amsterdam or live here, how many people will join and how much walking feels comfortable. For children, plan room for a pause and keep the route away from a tight sightseeing schedule. Agree the meeting point and a finish near your next stop. Crowds and access can change, so the exact route is confirmed for your date.

Portraits, families and celebrations

For portraits, share how you will use the images and whether you prefer the city to be recognisable or softly in the background. For a family session, share the ages of the children. For an event, send the venue and programme. Wedding plans have their own Amsterdam page, with coverage and travel considerations.

Location background: I amsterdam: Jordaan. Access and any permissions are confirmed for the proposed session.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

What to wear for a couples, portrait or family photoshoot

Choose clothes you can move, sit and breathe comfortably in. The most useful outfit is one that feels like you and works with the location. A cinematic photograph does not require a special wardrobe.

Read the guide ↗︎

What if it rains on your photoshoot day?

Make a weather plan before the day arrives. Cloud, a light shower and persistent rain call for different decisions. The aim is a session you can enjoy, with the final location and any changes agreed together.
